quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release (6-K Exhibit 99.1) product-line sales: SSD controller sales increased 5% to 10% Q/Q and 50% to 55% Y/Y; eMMC+UFS controller sales increased 15% to 20% Q/Q and 95% to 100% Y/Y; Ferri & Boot Drive solutions sales increased 110% to 115% Q/Q and 1,690% to 1,695% Y/Y. Q2 capital expenditures were $7.7 million, including $5.8 million for routine purchases of testing equipment, software, design tools and other items and $1.9 million for building construction and improvements.
quarterly_data.figure: SSD controllers +5% to 10% Q/Q, +50% to 55% Y/Y; eMMC+UFS +15% to 20% Q/Q, +95% to 100% Y/Y; Ferri & Boot Drive +110% to 115% Q/Q, +1,690% to 1,695% Y/Y; capex $7.7 million
